people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.
translations.bsb: Jesus answered, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick.
translations.kjv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are whole need not a physician; but they that are sick.
translations.asv: And Jesus answering said unto them, They that are in health have no need of a physician; but they that are sick.
